Insecure JWT secret fallback "fallback-secret" as string literal. If ADMIN_SECRET and NEXTAUTH_SECRET env vars are both missing, tokens can be forged.
NextAuth not implemented — /api/auth/[...nextauth] route missing. User/Account/Session models exist in Prisma schema but no auth routes or login/signup pages exist.
Stripe integration not implemented — dependency installed and Subscription model in schema, but zero API routes, webhooks, or pricing UI exist.
No input validation (Zod) on API routes — contact form, admin create/update endpoints accept unvalidated input.
No user signup/login pages exist despite NextAuth dependencies being installed and auth models in DB schema.
Database connection string with credentials exposed in audit report file (not in application code).
Contact form has no CSRF token protection — standard requirement for public forms.
Partner logos (16 entries) hardcoded in page.tsx — should be managed via admin panel or DB as dynamic content.
Each public page manually imports Navbar/Footer instead of using a shared layout — code duplication across all page files.
API Key management for users not implemented despite ApiKey model existing in Prisma schema.
Usage tracking / credits system not implemented despite UsageRecord model in schema.
No knowledge/ documentation files exist for the project.
